description: This file defines a stub object using ECMAScript Proxy to simulate a plugin SDK, providing default behaviors for various property accesses and function calls.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Simulates function application behavior of the stub proxy.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Simulates constructor behavior of the stub proxy.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles property access on the stub proxy, providing default responses for specific property names.

methods.name: ownKeys
methods.description: Returns the list of property keys for the stub object, including '__esModule' and 'default'.

methods.name: getOwnPropertyDescriptor
methods.description: Provides property descriptors for specific properties, particularly '__esModule' and 'default'.
